title: Smiling Toddler Boy in Wooden Playpen, 1956 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A joyous black-and-white snapshot taken in June 1956 capturing a grinning toddler boy standing up inside a wooden playpen surrounded by toys. The child is dressed in mid-century attire featuring a striped long-sleeved shirt, dark shorts, and suspenders. The scene provides a charming glimpse into everyday postwar domestic life and child-rearing during the mid-1950s American Baby Boom.
